name: spinoff_factor_check
universe: accepted U.S. corporate spinoffs in the SEC seeker registry with a filing-backed distribution date and first regular-way closing price
entry_rule: first regular-way close strictly after the filing-backed distribution date
outcome: unadjusted price return from the entry close to the first available close on or after entry plus 90 calendar days
comparison_rule: For every factor with available values, compare the equal-count high-priority and low-priority groups after sorting in its declared direction. Report the group count and every comparison. Do not change the rules after observing returns.
limitations: This is a pre-registered check, not a return claim. Missing filing facts or prices exclude a name from the affected comparison and must be reported.
